objective: Bring 20 Armor Scraps to Murgot Deepforge in Dun Baldar.

description: Battles rage constantly in Alterac Valley, and the supplies we get from Ironforge are not enough to outfit our experienced troops.
If you find armor scraps from the battlefield, aid the war effort and bring those scraps to me!
progress: Did you bring any armor scraps, <name>?
completion: These are some good pieces, <name>. I can use them to fashion new equipment for our troops.
If my supply level gets high enough, then maybe our seasoned fighting units will enter the field!
